title: Battle of Fort Stephenson
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Fort Stephenson", at revision 1370440972, opens: "The Battle of Fort Stephenson was a decisive American victory in Ohio during the War of 1812. American forces led by Major George Croghan successfully defended the fort during a two-day siege by British and Indigenous forces in August 1813." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4871058, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "war of 1812 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
